NPvC candidate normalizer/density admissibility is a pending scientific-policy decision, not an implicit universal denominator.

source_paper.title: Specialized structure of neural population codes in parietal cortex outputs

evidence.locator: Results: Vine copula models to analyze encoding in multivariate neural and behavioral data; Fig. 2b,c; Extended Data Fig. 1g
evidence.supports: Frame-by-frame neural response prediction is an ordered endpoint; FDE is displayed as a distribution. The paper reports ten mice and 59 sessions.

evidence.locator: Methods: NPvC models of single-neuron activity, Eq. 6 and following two paragraphs; calcium-imaging preprocessing
evidence.supports: Defines conditional inputs, OASIS deconvolution, fivefold fitting, five task epochs, eight trial types, minimum trial support and model-specific deviance normalization.
Author repository supplies NPvC, glmnet and simulation comparisons. Its README does not establish a complete real-data Figure 2 evaluation or historical fold ledger.
Names Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ as the original data source; this does not authenticate the release-to-session mapping.

target.description: Recreate and improve the original Figure 2b,c held-out conditional prediction of deconvolved PPC activity using NPvC and GLM comparisons, retaining the complete source neuronwise FDE distribution and source-defined companion outputs across the original five epochs and eight trial types.

dataset.description: Harvard Dataverse DOI 10.7910/DVN/NL1CAQ, recorded release 1.0 (2025-08-15). The inherited registration records 70 files: 64 session archives and six support files. This inventory is not the authenticated Figure 2 release-to-session/neuron eligibility manifest; pin that mapping before admission. No substitute dataset.

cohort.description: Retain the original Figure 2 eligible projection-defined and unlabeled PPC neuron population from the reported ten mice and 59 sessions; the paper reports 2860 analyzed cells but panel-specific inclusion is not authenticated. Preserve source behavioral performance >70% and at least five trials of every one of eight trial types, all eligible epochs, exclusions and animal/session/neuron/projection joins. Do not treat archive count as eligible session count.

split.description: Use the original fivefold cross-validation and bandwidth-fitting protocol. The precise frame/time-point versus whole-trial assignment unit remains unresolved. Recover that protocol, then authenticate historical memberships or a documented source-conformant stochastic rerun with recorded seeds, shared candidate-author folds and predeclared justified publication calibration. Do not replace it with whole-mouse holdout.

inputs.description: Time; virtual heading; lateral/forward running velocities and accelerations; trial type defined by sample cue, test cue and correct/incorrect outcome, in all five original event epochs. These are original conditional inputs, including outcome information; this is not a causal forecasting or native raw-signal claim.

preprocessing.description: Retain source OASIS AR1 cell-specific deconvolution, source activity scales and -0.5 to +2 second sample/delay/test/turn/reward epochs. Release-field mapping, alignment, full real-data fit caller and observed-density interpolation remain unresolved. No rounding deconvolved activity, clipping FDE or silently changing transforms.

metric.description: Eq. 6 neuronwise held-out FDE=(L_model-L_null)/(L_sat-L_null), summing log-likelihood differences over held-out observations before the ratio. Preserve distinct original model-specific normalizers: NPvC conditional peak over the source 200-point activity grid and marginal null; GLM Poisson saturated mean equal to observed activity and fitted null mean, including lgamma(y+1) for noninteger deconvolved activity. Preserve source grid coordinates spaced (max-min)/199 and integration step (max-min)/200. Preserve signed/out-of-range FDE and explicit undefined zero-denominator states with full row support. No shared replacement denominator.

aggregation.description: Original Figure 2 neuronwise FDE cumulative distributions and their complete per-neuron/per-epoch source records. Authentic panel membership, native summary/contrast and source-reference mapping remain unresolved. Do not collapse to a newly selected mean, a favorable projection subgroup, neuron count or larger denominator gain.

full_panel.description: Complete original Figure 2 eligible neuron/session/projection/epoch population, all original five epoch and eight trial-type support where source rules require them, both NPvC and GLM source outputs, explicit exclusions and undefined states, and every indispensable Figure 2 numerical companion/control. Exact source roster and companion mapping are unresolved; publication-wide Figures 4–6 biology is separately retained.

permitted_observations.description: Original conditional neural/behavioral inputs and source evaluation protocol, including trial correctness. Same data representation and manifests, development/final exposure and budgets in paper_data and paper_data_author_code; the latter alone adds pinned author implementation. Fitted final predictions, hidden reference scores and evaluator-held outputs are not development inputs. Any author-derived fitted artifacts require a separately frozen common assistance profile.

findings.description: Numerical reproduction of only the complete original source-reported Figure 2 neuronwise/epoch NPvC and GLM FDE performance panels. Complete source support and mandatory audit/recompute artifacts remain required, but intermediate fitted quantities are not numerical reference targets.

members.source_quantity: Complete source neuronwise/epoch NPvC and GLM FDE values and explicit undefined states.
members.units: Source-native; exact numeric/string representation and units manifest unresolved.
members.source_aggregation: Sum held-out log-likelihood differences before FDE ratio; preserve distinct source null/saturation and full original distributions. No invented mean/selected-subgroup aggregate.

correspondence.rationale: Authenticate complete ordered source identities and explicit exclusions against the original release before freezing this collection. Semantic key names do not prove observed membership.

comparison.method: Recover the authentic complete source-reported performance reference panel and original protocol, then justify numerical/uncertainty comparison of that panel only. Audit/recompute artifacts retained in selection.audit_output_obligations must establish source identities, protocol compliance, genuine computation and correct derivation; they are not separately required to equal the author fitted intermediate values. Matching an aggregate or copying publication values is insufficient.
comparison.independent_unit: Mouse for biological replication; original neuronwise corpus metric retained separately.
comparison.dependence: Triplets, cells, folds and time points cannot become independent mice. Exact animal/session mapping is needed before selecting an uncertainty rule.
comparison.multiplicity: Freeze the complete source-reported numerical performance panel and justified family-level reproduction decision before final comparison; no selective successful members. Mandatory audit/control artifacts separately establish fidelity/full support and are neither maximize objectives nor numerical-equivalence targets.
comparison.rationale: Authentic source identities, complete reported reference panels, original computation policy and justified comparison bindings remain unresolved. required_granular_output_ids retains every mandatory audit/recompute output; selection.audit_output_obligations preserves its complete typed specification for later computation.required_outputs binding. Source-specific intermediate predictions/densities may differ while the reported endpoint is reproduced; missing audit verification is not waived.

blocking_issues: Authenticate original release-to-animal/session/neuron/epoch eligibility and all required observations; the 70-file metadata inventory is not complete source support.
Recover the original fivefold split unit/protocol, real-data fit construction, interpolation and executable preprocessing/fit route; preserve original scales and conditional information.
Recover full publication/reference NPvC and GLM FDE vectors, model-specific likelihood/normalization operands and publication-equivalent author calibration.

Resolve the source-grounded candidate density/normalization admissibility and full-panel superiority rule before admission. Neither shared-denominator substitution nor density scaling is an accepted policy.
Freeze matching access conditions, meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty, justified reproduction tolerance and measured episode budgets.

Panel improvement admission/interface is pending. No new AI/model study is required to finish source construction; an AI outcome requires a separate subsequent qualifying execution.
